title: Resume a persistent conversation inside the KP editor
summary: User confirmed the persistent chat works. The rich chat request is a separately bounded successor.

verificationRecords.command: npm run test:editor-chat; npm run check:editor-chat:codex
verificationRecords.notes: 11 deterministic tests pass. Installed Codex 0.169.0 initializes, starts, disconnects and reconnects an unsent session. Initial native probe found no persisted rollout before the first turn; recovery now replaces only a provably never-submitted empty shell and preserves its draft. No inference requested; populated native thread resume remains for explicit user Send.

Initial HTTP test ignored a forged Host header; raw HTTP test now covers it. Initial private-path browser check missed encoded dot normalization; guard repaired. Installed native restart exposed absent empty rollout; only never-submitted shells can now restart. New tooling inventories initially rejected the added suite/plugin; exact additions reviewed, previous entries preserved. Roadmap/thread exceeded budgets by 15 words each; shortened without raising budgets. See linked evidence and passing reruns.

verificationRecords.scope: Six Chromium exemplar cases and final focused live-server guard
verificationRecords.notes: Real service and HTTP with deterministic RPC peer: streaming, resume, delayed Send, interrupt, uncertain delivery, two tabs, keyboard Send, light and phone layout. Native player remains mounted. Final real dev endpoint returns a validated snapshot and private paths return 403. No model inference claimed.

verificationRecords.command: npm run test:editor-chat; npm run typecheck:fraction-notebook; npm run test:fraction-notebook; npm run visual:fraction-notebook; npm run visual:anchored-algebra -- --grep fractional
verificationRecords.notes: 11 chat and 20 notebook unit tests; focused types; all 21 notebook browser cases and one canonical fractional reader case pass. Public reader closure unchanged. Final storage release is idempotent across overlapping Vite hooks.

verificationRecords.command: npm run test:project-vision; npm run check:tooling-configs; npm run theseus -- workspace validate
verificationRecords.notes: 75 project tests, five tooling tests, 72 Playwright configs with 173 projects, 14 Vite configs in both modes, 15 TypeScript projects and workspace validation pass. Broad full-repo release gates not run for this focused exemplar.
